title: Tangential gradient of a Lipschitz function on the carrier of an integer multiplicity triple: co-area formula, slice tangents, weak limits (Simon Ch. 3, §2 and Ch. 6, 4.1)
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, Measurable g ∧ (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict RT.carrier), g x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) RT.carrier x) ∧ (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in RT.carrier, ‖g x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]) ∧ (∀ t, CountablyRectifiable n (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})) ∧ (∀ t, (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) RT.carrier x ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g x)ᗮ)) ∧ (∀ (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∀ (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (hs k)) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ c) → TendstoUniformly hs (fun x => min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a)))) atTop → ∀ (W : Euclid P → Euclid P) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (c' : ℝ), Measurable W → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ x, x ∉ K → W x = 0) → (∀ x, ‖W x‖ ≤ c') → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict RT.carrier), W x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) RT.carrier x) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * fderiv ℝ (hs k) x (W x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * (-(b - a)⁻¹ * inner ℝ (g x) (W x)) ∂μHE[n + 1])))
